name: @majlis/contracts
//constants: ./constants is a zero-import subpath and ./problem imports only zod. The barrel re-exports all fifteen schema modules, and the bundler does not tree-shake through it, so a browser module that reads one value from '@majlis/contracts' ships every schema. Both subpaths exist for exactly that reason; the barrel still exports everything they hold.
//sideEffects: Nothing here runs on import: every export is a Zod schema or a constant. Saying so is what lets a bundler drop the ~40 schemas the web app never touches, instead of shipping all of zod plus this barrel to every route.

scripts.build: tsc -p tsconfig.json && tsc -p tsconfig.esm.json && node -e "require('node:fs').writeFileSync('dist/esm/package.json', JSON.stringify({type:'module'}))"
